summary_en: This study tests RiMO-301 given with hypofractionated radiation and pembrolizumab before surgery, for resectable, locally advanced head and neck cancer. RiMO-301 is injected into the tumor once on Day 0, followed by radiation of 5 fractions of 4-5 Gray over 5-15 days. Pembrolizumab 200 mg is given every 3 weeks for 2 cycles before surgery. The main outcome is major pathologic response; this is a phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa RiMO-301 administrado con radioterapia hipofraccionada y pembrolizumab antes de la cirugía, para cáncer de cabeza y cuello resecable y localmente avanzado. RiMO-301 se inyecta en el tumor una vez el Día 0, seguido de radioterapia de 5 fracciones de 4-5 Gray durante 5-15 días. Pembrolizumab 200 mg se administra cada 3 semanas durante 2 ciclos antes de la cirugía. El resultado principal es la respuesta patológica mayor; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Head and neck cancer that needs surgery to remove it.
At least one tumor that can be reached for injection and can receive radiation.
Recovered from acute side effects of prior cancer treatment to grade 1 or less.
Adequate blood counts and liver function, ECOG 0-2, and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
not_for: Symptomatic brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Anti-cancer treatment other than PD-1 inhibitors within 4 weeks before injection.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
